items.title_en: Russian Strike on Kyiv-Area Weapons Depot Kills 37 and Forces Hundreds to Flee
items.summary_en: Thirty-seven people have died and almost 400 residents have been evacuated after a Russian drone strike hit a depot storing Ukrainian military weapons near a residential area on the outskirts of Kyiv. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the strike triggered secondary detonations of shells, mines and drones late on Friday, and the blast damaged nearby properties including a care home for elderly and disabled people. Forty-two people were injured, four of them children, and a rescue operation continued on Saturday at the site in the Bucha district. Russia's Ministry of Defence said its forces had targeted an ammunition depot in the village of Myla holding components and launch boosters for long-range unmanned aerial vehicles. Zelensky said the storage site definitely should not have been there and announced criminal proceedings on charges of official negligence against those who stored explosives right next to people. It is the second munitions-depot disaster near Kyiv in recent months, after the July explosion in Vyshneve killed nine people and damaged more than 280 homes. Prime Minister Sergiy Koretsky said making the same mistakes over and over in the fifth year of the full-scale invasion was criminal negligence, and demanded severe punishment for everyone responsible without exception.
items.title_zh: 俄軍空襲基輔郊區武器庫 轟爆彈藥奪37命 近400居民緊急撤離
items.summary_zh: 一場俄羅斯無人機攻擊在基輔郊區一處存放烏克蘭軍方武器的儲藏庫旁爆炸，造成三十七人死亡，附近近四百名居民已緊急撤離。澤連斯基表示，這場攻擊在週五深夜引爆庫內存放的砲彈、地雷與無人機，爆炸波及周邊建物，包括一間收容長者與身心障礙者的安養院。四十二人受傷，其中包含四名兒童；週六在布查區的爆炸現場，救援行動仍在持續進行。俄羅斯國防部聲稱，其部隊鎖定的是邁拉村的一處彈藥庫，裡面存放長程無人空偵機的零組件與發射助推器。澤連斯基直言這處儲藏地點「絕對不該設在那裡」，並宣布以公職人員失職罪名，對把爆裂物存放在民居旁相關人員啟動刑事調查。這是近幾個月來基輔周邊第二起彈藥庫災難——七月維什內韋的爆炸曾造成九人死亡、超過二百八十戶住宅受損。總理科列茨基表示，全面入侵進入第五年還一再犯同樣的錯就是刑事疏忽，要求所有負責人無一例外都必須面對嚴厲懲處。

items.title_en: Fed Chair Warsh Says Bank Has 'Work to Do' on Inflation, Hints at Possible Rate Rise
items.summary_en: Federal Reserve chair Kevin Warsh has warned that policymakers will still have work to do if they are not confident that cost-of-living pressures are easing for Americans. Speaking at his first Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium in Wyoming, Warsh said recent inflation readings looked better than expected over the summer but had not meaningfully improved. Prices rose 3.4 percent in the year to July, well above the Fed's two percent target, while another inflation gauge the central bank watches closely is running at 3.7 percent. With prices rising by more than two percent annually, the Fed's predominant focus right now should be on prices, he said, adding that his standard is confidence that underlying inflation is moving toward the objective clearly and at sufficient speed. The Fed left interest rates unchanged between 3.5 and 3.75 percent in July for a fifth consecutive meeting, partly because the ongoing conflict between the US and Iran has pushed global oil prices higher. Its next rate decision comes on 15 and 16 September, and analysts at Capital Economics said Warsh delivered a far clearer and decidedly hawkish message that left the door open to an earlier rate rise. After his remarks, rates markets immediately raised their expectations of a September hike.
items.title_zh: 聯準會主席沃什：通膨未歇就「還有工作要做」 釋出了可能升息的鷹派訊號
items.summary_zh: 美國聯邦準備理事會主席沃什警告，若決策者無法確信美國人的生活成本壓力正在緩解，他們就還有工作要做。沃什在懷俄明州首次出席傑克森霍爾經濟政策研討會演說時表示，夏季公佈的通膨數據看來比預期好，但整體情況並未出現「有意義的改善」。七月的年度通膨率為百分之三點四，遠高於聯準會百分之二的目標；聯準會密切關注的另一項通膨指標也維持在百分之三點七。他說，既然物價年增率仍在百分之二以上，聯準會目前最該專注的就是物價；他的標準是必須確信核心通膨正以明確且足夠的速度朝目標回落，否則就還有功課要做。由於美伊衝突推升國際油價，聯準會七月第五度按兵不動，將利率維持在百分之三點五到三點七五之間。下次利率決策將於九月十五、十六日作出；Capital Economics分析師評論，沃什釋出了遠比過去清楚、明顯偏鷹派的訊號，為提早升息打開了大門。談話一出，利率市場對九月升息的預期應聲升高。

items.title_en: Jones Cup: Chinese Taipei Blue Fight Back Twice but Fall to Japan 66-75 for Runner-Up
items.summary_en: Chinese Taipei Blue came up just short at home, losing 66-75 to Japan in the gold-medal game of the 45th William Jones Cup International Basketball Invitational on Saturday night at the Xinzhuang Gymnasium in New Taipei. Japan, fielding the same Nagoya Asian Games core as their opponents, raced to a 12-0 lead in the opening seven and a half minutes and finished the first quarter ahead 16-4. The home side refused to surrender as Lin Wen-yu answered with nine straight points, including back-to-back three-pointers, to shrink the deficit before halftime. Chen Yan-yu drilled consecutive triples and finished a three-point play to square the game late in the third quarter, and Feng Shih-ching and Lin Yu-ting levelled it once more early in the fourth. Japan found an answer every time, with tournament MVP Miyu Okamoto and Ami Tokida hitting three-pointers to wrest back control. Feng Shih-ching buried two late triples to close within five points with 71 seconds remaining, but Japan held on for a perfect record and a fifth consecutive Jones Cup crown. Head coach Kenzo Maeda praised his players' never-give-up attitude, while Lin Wen-yu said the losing experience was precious and Chinese Taipei can still beat Japan at the Asian Games after fixing the problems exposed on Saturday.
items.title_zh: 瓊斯盃／中華藍兩度追平仍功虧一簣 66：75不敵日本屈居亞軍
items.summary_zh: 第四十五屆新北威廉瓊斯盃國際籃球邀請賽女子組金牌戰週六晚間在新莊體育館登場，中華藍隊以六十六比七十五惜敗日本，在家門前與冠軍擦身而過。日方與中華藍一樣以名古屋亞運主力為班底，開賽七分半鐘就打出十二比零的攻勢，首節打完以十六比四領先。中華藍隊沒有放棄，林文佑回敬一波連續九分、包含兩記三分球，上半場結束前把落後幅度縮小。陳晏宇第三節連中兩發三分球，再以一次「三分打」把比數追平；第四節開局彭詩晴與林育庭聯手又扳回平手。但日本每次都能回應，由本屆最有價值球員岡本美優與常田亞美接連投進三分球，重新奪回主導權。彭詩晴終場前一分十一秒連中兩記三分球追到只差五分，日本仍守住勝利，以全勝之姿完成瓊斯盃五連霸。總教練前田顯藏讚揚球員不放棄的態度；林文佑則說輸球的經驗很珍貴，相信修正問題後，中華藍仍有機會在亞運的大舞台擊敗日本。
